Specification: This module specifies a PlusCal algorithm with procedures and procedure calls, translated into TLA+. It models call/return behavior using a program counter `pc`, an explicit `stack`, and procedure-local variables for procedures `P`, `Q`, `PP`, `R`, and `S`, with comments noting a translator bug involving incorrect initialization of local procedure variables and assertions showing the intended initialized values. The specification initializes state, defines atomic actions for each control location and return step, gives a stuttering-enabled terminating action, defines `Spec` with weak fairness on `Next`, and asserts the liveness property `Termination == <>(pc = "Done")`.
